verdict.rationale: Check's evidence shows only that employees can sign tax forms inside the Onboard Component and that the API exposes employee tax documents. That is tax-form handling, not sending offer letters or general HR documents for e-signature. There is no evidence of uploading custom HR documents, routing them for signature, or keeping a per-employee repository of them.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
